indeg.note: indeg v: the number of in-neighbours #|[set u | u --> v]|, the companion of outdeg; a loop counts once; swaps with outdeg on the converse digraph.

balanced.note: balanced D: every vertex has equal in- and out-degree; no connectivity, looplessness, inhabitance or tour premise; invariant under converse; holds on the empty, arcless and loop digraphs and on disconnected unions of balanced digraphs.

balancedb.note: balancedb D: the Boolean [forall v, indeg v == outdeg v], reflected to balanced by balancedP.
